body: This only happens when the Docker build is used to run the `native-image` (which explains the `/project` directory in the error message) and the executable is running locally. It looks like the `user.home` path is being stored during buildtime in this case.
Reopening to investigate why the `user.home` is stored during build time in the JGit library

issue.title: Do not cache user.home during build time
